scope:
Check artificial face slip from a rigid-spin-only fluid reconstruction.

Exact smooth affine fields; internal faces only. Unit damping per unit face
length is a diagnostic, not a proposed physical viscosity coefficient.
decision: Do not connect rigid-spin-only slip damping to the Kepler solver. A full affine trace passes this null test, but force work must then include affine deformation degrees of freedom; pair torque alone does not close it.
limits: No time evolution or physical viscosity calibrated.
Affine null test is necessary, not sufficient for curved shear, residual transport or shocks.
